title: Recalling Home: a soundscape offering for Rapanui treasures
author: Mario Amahiro Tuki, Sebastián Yancovic Pakarati and Andrés Pakarati

notes.text: A 16-minute 32-second composition of natural and human-made sounds recorded on Rapa Nui and presented to Hoa Hakananai'a at the British Museum on 8 January 2024. The museum page says the offering honours Rapanui tao'a including Hoa Hakananai'a and Moai Hava and was made with permission from the three co-authors, in collaboration with museum staff and sound designer Farokh Soltani. The soundscape creates a relation across displacement; this record does not treat it as a substitute for physical return or adopt the museum's custodial framing. The audio contains several kinds of sound and voice, so the source language is recorded as undetermined. No audio or image is republished.
